snippet.title: Fully Automated - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Fully Automated is a fast paced action roguelite. Destroy or demoralize your foes, and shape the future of your world ! 

Face relentless waves of enemies and choose from a variety of upgrades and traits to create the perfect style. 

Will you be a force for peace or a demon of war?

Steam Page : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1370830/Fully_Automated/
